paragraphs.text: Set your context, begin your first Clarity session, use the Companion, and establish an operating rhythm that can carry relevant change forward over time.
Start with the context that matches your work today.
Return through daily and weekly rhythm to see what changed and continue without rebuilding context each time.
Start with one real decision and finish with a clear next action.
